title: Optimistic Online Learning for Coding Agents with Aggregate Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.30405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents operating on Web development platforms can interact with repositories, issue trackers, and continuous integration services to carry out long-horizon software engineering tasks. However, behavioral drift remains a major bottleneck in such multi-turn reasoning and action trajectories. To mitigate this, activation steering has emerged as a promising approach for regularizing agent behaviors by intervening on the LLM's transformer residual streams. Nonetheless, existing methods typically apply a static steering policy across all tasks, overlooking the fact that a single policy is rarely effective across heterogeneous tasks and varying execution turns. This limitation motivates dynamic online selection among candidate steering policies. translated_title: 面向聚合反馈下编码智能体的乐观在线学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.30405v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在Web开发平台上运行的大语言模型（LLM）编码智能体可以与代码仓库、问题跟踪系统和持续集成服务进行交互，以完成长时程的软件工程任务。然而，行为漂移仍然是此类多轮推理与动作轨迹中的主要瓶颈。为缓解这一问题，激活引导（activation steering）已成为一种有前景的方法，它通过干预LLM的Transformer残差流来规范智能体的行为。尽管如此，现有方法通常在所有任务上应用静态的引导策略，忽视了这样一个事实：单一策略在异构任务和不同的执行轮次中很少能普遍有效。这一局限性促使人们研究在候选引导策略中进行动态在线选择。然而，在长时程智能体场景中这样做极具挑战性：可验证的任务级反馈只有在任务完成后才会被揭示，导致各个单独动作的贡献难以……
tldr: 该论文提出用乐观在线学习方法在候选激活引导策略中进行动态选择，以应对任务级反馈仅在任务完成时才以聚合形式给出、难以归因的挑战，从而缓解编码智能体在长时程软件工程任务中的行为漂移问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes optimistic online learning to dynamically select among candidate activation steering policies for coding agents, tackling the challenge that verifiable task-level feedback is only revealed in aggregate upon task completion, thereby mitigating behavioral drift in long-horizon software engineering tasks.
